final_verdict.reason: DD 6/20 tightening did not achieve MDD 25% target (29.28%). CAGR dropped below 16% (15.58%). Parent DD 8/22 (Grade A, SR=1.080, CAGR=16.09%, MDD=29.8%) remains the optimal configuration. This mutation demonstrates diminishing returns from DD parameter tightening — the marginal MDD reduction does not justify CAGR sacrifice.
final_verdict.recommendation: Retain parent DD 8/22 as confirmed optimal. Further MDD reduction requires structural changes (defense sleeve, conditional allocation) rather than DD parameter tuning.
